actions.body:
Autonomous systems require self-generated goals and open-ended learning mechanisms to acquire flexible skills in unpredictable environments. By moving beyond fixed von Neumann paradigms toward embodied, hybrid architectures, agents can discover and pursue significant problems without explicit human instruction.

Summary
This post reviews how goal-driven autonomous systems can independently formulate and investigate open-ended problems.
